note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (kit starter, cross-checked against the GamesFuze list). Hidden flags verified against the GamesFuze list on 2026-11-21: 27 visible, 28 hidden. Guides are this entry's own words.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies first — the Platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops.
Work through this guide's roadmap in order, so nothing is left for a second playthrough.
End on A Long Road (100% completion) as your final trophy.
trophies.guide: The Platinum is the reward for the other 54 trophies: there is no separate task of its own. Follow the roadmap in this guide — story first, then strangers, activities, crime and collectibles — and finish on 100% completion. Expect around 200 hours in total.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes — it cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: The first trophy of the game: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is a story trophy, so it unlocks naturally as you play the opening.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through every story mission in Chapter 1.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends — no extra task is needed.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Every story mission in the chapter counts toward it; there is nothing extra to do beyond playing the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through every story mission in Chapter 2.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 in full. Like the other chapter trophies, it unlocks by playing the story to the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through every story mission in Chapter 3.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full. It unlocks by playing the story to the end of the chapter, with no extra requirement.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through every story mission in Chapter 4.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 in full. It unlocks by playing the story to the end of the chapter, with no extra requirement.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play the story through to its final mission.
Complete the final mission — the trophy pops at its end.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It pops at the end of the last mission, with no separate task. Beebom and CULTR describe this final stretch as Chapter 5.

trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the story mission Breakfast Run through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the story mission Child's Play through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is a story-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing the mission to its end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the story mission Headliners through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It is a story-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. It is a story-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a story-mission trophy, so it unlocks by playing the mission to its end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Open the 100% checklist in the stats menu and work through every requirement: story, strangers, activities, collectibles and side tasks.
Clear one group at a time, using this guide's roadmap stages as the order.
The trophy pops the moment the checklist hits 100%.
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game, and the last one most players earn: reach 100% completion. GamesFuze names it the hardest trophy alongside The Shootist. It is the longest grind in the game, so save it for the end and clear it group by group.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Pull off stunts while driving — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count.
Chain them on open stretches of highway and around Vice City's jumps.
The counter runs across the whole game, so check the stats menu to see how far along you are.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any stunt counts — jumps, drifts, near misses and airtime — and they add up across the entire playthrough, so this finishes naturally if you drive boldly throughout the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
steps: Try each of the 9 activity types once — the game's activities menu lists them.
Fishing, bowling, the shooting range, drone races and the rest: one go at each is enough.
The trophy pops after the ninth type.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — there are 9 in total. One attempt at each is enough; you do not need to win or finish any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
steps: Visit the Shooting Range and work through all 42 challenges.
Gold medals need accuracy and speed — use the weapon each challenge favours and learn the target patterns.
Leave this for after the story, when your aim and weapon handling are practised.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. GamesFuze calls this one of the two hardest trophies, with A Long Road. Gold needs both accuracy and speed, so practise each challenge's pattern rather than rushing it.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race at each of its 14 locations around Leonida.
Win each race — learn the gates on a practice run first.
The trophy pops after the 14th win.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 in total. Each race is a short course through gates; a practice run to learn the route makes the win much easier.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races around Leonida — street, off-road and water races all count.
Win 20 different races; repeats of the same race do not add to the count.
Vary the race type and the vehicle class to cover new ones quickly.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Only first wins on new races count, so rotate through race types and locations instead of replaying one favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
steps: Take on a fishing challenge against Cal.
Match his catch or beat his score — steady reeling beats fast reeling.
The trophy pops when you win the challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are won by steady reeling and not letting the line snap; take your time rather than rushing the reel.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade machine in Vice City and start any game.
Play it through to the end of a round — finishing one game is enough.
The trophy pops when the game ends.
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any arcade machine in Vice City will do, and one finished game — win or lose — is enough.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_note: Time-sensitive: stranger mission chains close as the story advances (TechWiser, via EGamers). Finish Andy's strand when it appears.
steps: Pick up Andy's stranger strand when it appears and follow it to its last mission.
Finish the strand before the story moves past its window — stranger chains close as chapters advance.
The trophy pops after Andy's final mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of five stranger chains with a window tied to story progress, so do it when it appears rather than leaving it for the endgame.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_note: Time-sensitive: stranger mission chains close as the story advances (TechWiser, via EGamers). Finish Kenton's strand when it appears.
steps: Pick up Kenton's stranger strand when it appears and follow it to its last mission.
Finish the strand before the story moves past its window.
The trophy pops after Kenton's final mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is one of five stranger chains with a window tied to story progress, so do it when it appears rather than leaving it for the endgame.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_note: Time-sensitive: stranger mission chains close as the story advances (TechWiser, via EGamers). Finish Billy's strand when it appears.
steps: Pick up Billy's stranger strand when it appears and follow it to its last mission.
Finish the strand before the story moves past its window.
The trophy pops after Billy's final mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is one of five stranger chains with a window tied to story progress, so do it when it appears rather than leaving it for the endgame.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
steps: Find stranger mission strands across Leonida — they appear as encounters on the map.
Complete 8 full strands; each strand is several missions.
Track them in the roadmap tab — the eight strands are listed there.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Each strand is a short chain of missions; finish eight of them and the Silver pops. Note that five of the strands have windows tied to story progress, so do them as they appear.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_note: Time-sensitive: stranger mission chains close as the story advances (TechWiser, via EGamers). Finish Randy's strand when it appears.
steps: Pick up Randy's stranger strand when it appears and follow it to its last mission.
Finish the strand before the story moves past its window.
The trophy pops after Randy's final mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is one of five stranger chains with a window tied to story progress, so do it when it appears rather than leaving it for the endgame.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_note: Time-sensitive: stranger mission chains close as the story advances (TechWiser, via EGamers). Finish Tyrone's strand when it appears.
steps: Pick up Tyrone's stranger strand when it appears and follow it to its last mission.
Finish the strand before the story moves past its window.
The trophy pops after Tyrone's final mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is one of five stranger chains with a window tied to story progress, so do it when it appears rather than leaving it for the endgame.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Possibly missable: the meditation spot at Jason's house is only available in Chapter 1 (GTABase and PowerPyx, as reported by EGamers). Do it as soon as it appears.
steps: Find meditation spots across Leonida — there are 18 in total.
Meditate at each one. The first spot is at Jason's house and is only open in Chapter 1, so do it early.
Keep a checklist — the tracker in this guide lists the count.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. This is the one trophy the guides flag as possibly missable: the spot at Jason's house is only open in Chapter 1, so meditate there before the story moves on.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
steps: Pick up Bret's stranger strand and follow it to the hunt.
Track the unique animal Bret asks for — take it down with one clean shot.
The trophy pops when the hunt is complete.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's stranger strand to the hunt, then track the animal down and take it.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards around Leonida — they are tucked into shops, hideouts and side locations.
Complete 3 full card sets; the tracker in this guide counts the sets.
Keep collecting as you roam — cards turn up wherever you explore.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets, and use the checklist here to track how many sets are done.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app on the in-game phone at 100 different locations.
The app scans each spot — move on once a location registers.
City landmarks, beaches and countryside spots all count.
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Open it wherever you go and let it scan; the counter climbs as you travel, so this finishes naturally if you scan often.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the Challenges menu and work through its list.
Complete any 50 challenges — combat, driving, exploration and side tasks all count.
Pick the easiest ones first; the counter tracks your progress.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Any 50 from the Challenges menu count, so start with the quick ones — driving, exploration and combat — and the total builds up over the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
steps: Raise a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you.
Lose the cops — break line of sight, swap cars and hide until the stars clear.
The trophy pops when the Wanted Level clears with your partner beside you.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the cops to 4 stars, then break line of sight and hide until the heat dies down.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: With your partner, rob a shop and get away clean.
Rob two more shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level in between.
Plan the route first — three shops close together make it far easier.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Pick three shops close together, hit them in sequence and keep moving.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive every vehicle type you find — each new type registers once.
Check the stats menu to see which types you still need.
Rare types hide in specific areas, so sweep garages, docks and the countryside.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle type you drive registers once, so hop into anything unfamiliar — the counter rewards variety, not repeats.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
steps: Trigger Combat Focus during a firefight.
Take down 5 enemies before the focus ends — group them first with cover fire.
The trophy pops on the fifth takedown in one use.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait until enemies cluster, trigger Combat Focus and chain the takedowns before it runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
steps: Head to VCIA, the Vice City airport.
Board a plane without a ticket — an unscheduled departure.
The trophy pops once you are airborne.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to the airport, board a plane you were never booked on and take off.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank — it appears at high Wanted Levels and in military areas.
Get inside one and cause chaos, or take one on.
The trophy pops once the Rhino encounter plays out.
trophies.guide: A secret involving a Rhino tank. Rhinos appear at high Wanted Levels and around military sites — get into one and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and case it first — learn the guard patrols and camera spots.
Rob it without being detected: stay out of sight and move quietly.
The trophy pops when you escape unseen.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, learn the patrols, then move quietly — being spotted at any point voids the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Hit bank vaults across Leonida — five in total.
Rob each vault and escape the police response.
Plan the getaway before you go in; the escape is the hard part.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, five getaways — plan the escape route first, because the police response is the part that fails most attempts.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road and stop it.
Rob the truck, then lose the police.
The trophy pops once you escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the cash and break away before the police box you in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Explore every part of Leonida — 52 areas in total.
The map fills in as you visit each area; check the stats menu for gaps.
Sweep the countryside and the islands last, as they are the easiest to miss.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas. Visit every district, beach and back road; the map shades in as you go, and the trophy pops when the last area is found.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
steps: Find an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Rob one operation per gang — each gang's turf is marked on the map.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs. One robbery per gang's turf is enough; work through the map gang by gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a bar with a view.
Order a cocktail and enjoy it with the view.
The trophy pops once the drink is served.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a beachfront bar, order a cocktail and take in the view — the simplest trophy in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom.
Smash your way out in classic style — through the glass, not the door.
The trophy pops once you are out.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive in, then leave through the showroom glass — the way the classics did it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
steps: Visit the bowling alley run by Kolt & Associates.
Play a game through — follow-through is the point.
The trophy pops at the end of the game.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game of bowling; finishing it is what counts.

trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Build your partnership's profile — the trophy is about your duo's reputation.
Complete partner activities together until the moment triggers.
The trophy pops on a partnership milestone.
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Play the partner storyline and activities together; the trophy marks a milestone in your duo's reputation.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices throughout the story — the game tracks them.
Some choices count more than others; keep playing and deciding.
The trophy pops once enough choices are recorded (PSN tracks a count toward 500).
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Keep making story choices — the game tracks them, and the trophy pops once enough have been recorded.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail at something, then try again.
Succeed on the second attempt.
The trophy pops on the successful retry.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail a task, then succeed on the retry — the trophy is for the comeback, not the first try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Wander Leonida and keep an eye out for something strange.
Weird encounters and odd sights trigger it.
The trophy pops when you witness the strange event.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Somewhere in Leonida something strange is waiting to be seen — wander, look around and the trophy finds you.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
steps: Get into a vehicle and build up speed.
From the moving vehicle, land a melee hit on a target as you drive past.
The trophy pops on the hit.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. From a moving vehicle, land a melee hit on a target — the trophy is for the drive-by, not the crash.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
steps: Earn Marked Bills through heists and crime jobs.
Launder them through your contacts — the laundering menu tracks the total.
Keep going until $250,000 is laundered.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from crime jobs; launder them steadily through your contacts until the total hits $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend money across all shops — clothes, weapons, food and more.
The total is cumulative across every shop.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts toward the total, so this builds up naturally as you gear up — or burn through cash on clothes and cars.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Buy garage properties around Leonida — 8 in total.
Each garage costs money, so save up between purchases.
The trophy pops after the eighth garage.
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Save up and buy each garage as you go; the eighth purchase pops the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone.
Register vehicles to the app — 10 in total.
Any vehicles you own or find count.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app and register ten vehicles — owned or found, either counts.
